department: Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by December 31, 2026 for Fall 2027; all materials must arrive by then.

also.quote: The application deadline is December 31st for the following fall quarter.

supervisor.value: Applicants must name at least one faculty advisor and should email them directly; there are no rotations, and the selecting professor becomes the research advisor.
supervisor.quote: All Ph.D. and M.S. candidates including ESAP are required on the application to select at least one faculty advisor. It is important that you contact the faculty by email directly. | There are no rotations between labs. | Students are selected to the Ph.D. or M.S. program by one of the faculty selected.

funding.value: Ph.D. students are fully supported (stipend, tuition and fees); discuss funding with the chosen advisor.
funding.quote: Ph.D. candidates are fully supported by the department (stipend, tuition & fees). Applicants should directly contact the faculty research advisers selected regarding funding.

entry_route.value: No master's is needed to apply for the Ph.D.
entry_route.quote: A student does not need to have a M.S degree in order to apply for the Ph.D. program.
